---
title: "How the report earns your trust"
---

The registry covers players who played football at IMG Academy. Camps and training-only attendance do not qualify. Each registry entry has an NFL player ID and an affiliation source. Current roster status is refreshed on every run; game statistics use the roster and team for the reporting week.

Positive offensive, defensive, or special-teams snaps establish participation. Recorded football plays or positive game statistics can also establish participation. Missing statistics do not establish a DNP. Zero snaps do not establish why a player did not play. Injury designations are attributed to that week's published report, and never treated as proof of absence. Illness or benching requires an explicit credible source.

Reports use nflverse's schedule, weekly roster, player statistics, play-by-play, snap counts, injury reports, and player metadata. Score agreement and offensive-yardage reconciliation are checks within these datasets. They do not constitute independent verification against an official gamebook. Optional missing feeds are labeled. Mandatory missing, stale, conflicting, or ambiguous data stop the build.

Key plays are selected by the absolute value of expected points added (EPA). EPA measures change in offensive team scoring expectation on the whole play. It is not an individual grade; negative offensive EPA can reflect a positive defensive result. No blocking grades, player trajectories, or route animations are invented. Detailed nflverse participation data from 2023 onward arrives after the season, not weekly.

Tuesday at 9 a.m. America/New_York is the intended reporting time, including postseason. Manual workflow runs are enabled initially. Scheduling remains disabled until manual review is complete. Source freshness is checked every run, but NFL stat corrections can arrive later in the week. A Thursday correction pass is recommended before calling an edition settled.

Data is attributed to [nflverse](https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data). See [availability](https://nflreadr.nflverse.com/articles/nflverse_data_schedule.html). Third-party images are not covered by the code license. This is an independent portfolio project, not an official IMG Academy or NFL publication.
